name: qwen3-tts-12hz-1.7b-ru-stress-cf
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-Base (config.json max_position_embeddings None). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-Base: 0 full GQA layers (kv heads 1, head_dim None) and 0 other layers, per the base config.json.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-25. A finetune of Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-Base, not a new base model: same config.json, same 1.929 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-10-04. Caveats: the two rows measure mark-following on deliberately adversarial text (marks that contradict the dictionary), 130 sentences / ~730 marks, two sampling seeds, judged by a stress detector rather than a reference WER. Russian only. Root of the repo is the merged checkpoint; lora/ is the adapter on its own, so this is not adapter-only.
